info.background_text:
An enhanced Replica of the Peltion.
Replicas, artificial lifeforms created by Kaguya Pharmaceutical. She used to be called by her Entity Code, NA-02. She shares a mental connection with her flying wyrm, Elysion, and controls it to attack her enemies. As someone who was originally brought into this world just to suffer, she unintentionally harbors a deep, fundamental weariness and bitterness toward life.
